title: Kiln thinking-budget contract v1
description: Canonical fragments for thinking-budget request overrides, server defaults, effective resolution, terminal outcomes, complete records, and partial recent-request records. The token and decode-time dimensions resolve independently.

limitOverride.description: One present request override. Property absence means inherit; null means explicitly unlimited; a non-negative integer is a finite limit, including zero.

oneOf.description: Explicitly remove the inherited finite limit for this dimension.
Finite limit. Zero starts reasoning-block closure at the first decode candidate.

source.description: Closed provenance vocabulary for one independently resolved token or time dimension. An `_unlimited` suffix means that surface explicitly removed an inherited limit.

trigger.description: Boundary that made Kiln force the reasoning close sequence: the thinking-token limit, decode-time limit, or remaining completion-token capacity.

request.description: Thinking-budget properties embedded in a chat or batch request. Other request properties are permitted because this definition describes only the budget fragment.

thinking_budget_tokens.description: Maximum generated thinking tokens before Kiln closes an open reasoning block. Omit to inherit the server token default.

thinking_budget_ms.description: Maximum decode time in milliseconds, starting at the first decode candidate and excluding queue and prefill. Omit to inherit the server time default.

serverDefaults.description: Resolved server-wide defaults. Null means the dimension is unlimited; a non-negative integer is finite, including zero.

default_thinking_budget_tokens.description: Default thinking-token limit inherited by requests that omit `thinking_budget_tokens`.

default_thinking_budget_ms.description: Default decode-time limit inherited by requests that omit `thinking_budget_ms`.

oneOf.description: Finite default decode-time limit in milliseconds.

effective.description: Independently resolved token and time dimensions before runtime applicability or outcome is known. `configured` is true exactly when at least one finite maximum is present.

configured.description: Whether at least one of `max_tokens` or `max_time_ms` is finite.

max_tokens.description: Effective finite thinking-token limit. Absence means this dimension is unlimited.

max_time_ms.description: Effective finite decode-time limit in milliseconds. Absence means this dimension is unlimited.

tokens_source.description: Surface that supplied the finite token limit or explicit/inherited unlimited state.

time_source.description: Surface that supplied the finite time limit or explicit/inherited unlimited state.

outcome.description: Completion-specific terminal state after the budget controller ran. Natural closure has `triggered=false` and no `trigger`.

triggered.description: Whether Kiln forced the close sequence because a finite or completion-capacity boundary was reached.

trigger.description: Boundary that forced closure. Present exactly when `triggered` is true.

closed.description: Whether the tokenizer's complete reasoning close sequence entered model history.

thinking_tokens.description: Thinking tokens produced before closure or before the request ended.

thinking_time_ms.description: Decode time from the first candidate to closure or request end, in milliseconds.

record.description: Complete effective configuration, applicability, and optional flat terminal outcome written by current chat, streaming, batch, and eval surfaces.

applied.description: Whether the request began in reasoning with a configured finite limit and the controller ran.

triggered.description: Whether a finite or completion-capacity boundary forced closure. False also covers inert and natural-close records.

trigger.description: Boundary that forced closure. Absent when no forced closure occurred.

closed.description: Whether the complete reasoning close sequence entered model history.

thinking_tokens.description: Thinking tokens observed before closure or request end.

thinking_time_ms.description: Decode time observed from the first candidate to closure or request end, in milliseconds.

recentRecord.description: Recent-request form of the effective record. `applied` and outcome fields may be absent when failure occurred before applicability or terminal state was known.

applied.description: Whether the configured controller applied. Absence means applicability was not established.

triggered.description: Whether a known terminal outcome forced closure.

closed.description: Whether the complete reasoning close sequence is known to have entered model history.

thinking_tokens.description: Known thinking-token count at closure or request end.

thinking_time_ms.description: Known decode time from first candidate to closure or request end, in milliseconds.
